description: A painted, dimly lit office desk with a beige boxy desktop computer, a CRT monitor on top showing green text, and a separate beige keyboard in front. A hand is pushing a black floppy disk into the drive slot on the case, and stacks of floppy disks and loose papers sit on the desk. A green desk lamp glows at the left and a lamp at the upper right. The case has a small 'IBM' badge. Edge to edge, no frame.
